The Router's observation of the arm merging with the fish is likely accurate and indicative of an AI generation artifact (fusion), which is common in complex interaction scenes. The severity of 2.5 is appropriate; it's noticeable but doesn't destroy the entire scene. The 'texture_anomaly' (severity 1.5) is also valid; the skin is overly smooth/plastic-like compared to the rough scutes, typical of AI 'waxiness'.

This partial conformance prevents a higher score, but the strong classifier confidence and visible scutes keep it above average.
